subject: RELEASE statement
notes: kb/Work PB322 F. cite.py --check 14.9.32.4 'If the number of bytes to be released to the sort operation is greater than the number of bytes in record-name-1, the content of the bytes that extend beyond the end of record-name-1 are undefined.' -> OK §14.9.32.4 6); Annex A.2 item 45 makes the content implementor latitude. The over-length release now EXISTS in both realizations of GR13 (the DEPENDING ON item, and the implied Format 1 whose size is the largest record description's) and its content is the determination docs/CONFORMANCE.md §3 D-WRT1 makes for WRITE and REWRITE: position n past the end of record-name-1 is position n of the record area. Witness 85/pb322_release_short_record_fixed_sd: SD with 01 A X(4) and 01 B X(10), RELEASE A releases the 10-byte area (AAAAZZZZZZ), RELEASE A FROM F4 moves first then releases (CCCCQQQQQQ).
